openwrt_wiki.Hinweis: In general, the advice and documentation regarding WNDR3700v1 and WNDR3700v2 is also valid for WNDR3800. The only differences are with amounts of RAM and flash memory. ... There is also a WNDR3800-1CHNAS which will not respond to the normal WNDR3800 images. Applying this patch does create a usable image.
openwrt_wiki.Installation: OEM-Web-UI (Administration > Firmware Upgrade) mit squashfs-factory.img; TFTP wie WNDR3700
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout OEM: uboot 320KiB, env 128KiB, rootfs 14592KiB, config 64KiB, config_bak 64KiB, pot 64KiB, traffic_meter 64KiB, language 1024KiB, caldata 64KiB
openwrt_wiki.Flash Layout OpenWrt: u-boot 320k ro, u-boot-env 128k ro, firmware 15872k, art 64k ro
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog OEM: Linux 2.6.15, flash_size 16, memory 08000000 (128 MiB), sn 2M93235C00263, hw_id:29763654+16+128, model_id:WNDR3800, REGION: WW
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog OpenWrt 2012: SoC: Atheros AR7161 rev 2; Clocks: CPU:680.000MHz, DDR:340.000MHz, AHB:170.000MHz; m25p80 spi0.0: mx25l12805d (16384 Kbytes); RTL8366 ver. 1 chip found; ath9k: Atheros AR9280 Rev:2 (phy0); console ttyS0,115200
openwrt_wiki.Serial: Internal J1 4-pin connector; Pin1 3.3V, Pin2 TX, Pin3 RX, Pin4 GND; 3.3V serial port voltage; 115200, 8, 1, none, none
openwrt_wiki.JTAG: Internal J3 connector, 14 pin header: 1 TRST, 2 GND, 3 TDI, 4 GND, 5 TDO, 6 GND, 7 TMS, 8 GND, 9 TCK, 10 GND, 11 RST, 12 NC, 13 NC, 14 3.3VDC
openwrt_wiki.Opening the case: Torx (T8); two screws visible on the bottom; four more screws under the rubber feet
openwrt_wiki.Recovery: TFTP in failsafe: Reset-Knopf an der Gehäuseunterseite beim Einschalten halten, 192.168.1.1, factory.img (nicht sysupgrade), nach 45-60 s erreichbar
openwrt_wiki.Zurueck zu Netgear: mtd -r erase firmware, dann tftp WNDR3800.img
openwrt_wiki.Tags: AR7161 GigabitEthernet 5Port 2NIC USB 1USB JTAG 802.11bgn ath9k 802.11abgn_simultan 128RAM 16Flash MIPS MIPS32 24Kc

openwrt_wiki_wndr3700.Hardware details v2: Atheros AR7161 rev 2 680 MHz, 64MiB, 16MiB, 1 WAN + 4x LAN (GBit), AR9220 [an 2x2:2] + AR9223 [bgn 2x2:2], USB Yes, Serial Yes, JTag Yes
openwrt_wiki_wndr3700.TFTP: Hold the 'System Restore' button on the underside of the router while powering it on, until the power led steadily blinks green; firmware.img als Dateiname
openwrt_wiki_wndr3700.Serial: Internal J1 4-pin connector. 3.3V serial port voltage. You don't need to - and should not - connect the 3.3V line to most common USB converters. 115200 8N1, no flow control
openwrt_wiki_wndr3700.Antenna Mod: Revision 2 only has U.FL connectors for the 5 GHz antennas (PJ2 and PJ4), while the 2.4 GHz connectors are replaced with dummy connectors
